intent: Design and validate an enforced, nonce-based built-app Content Security Policy while preserving authentication, framing denial, loopback HTTP and supported browser journeys.
invariants: A fresh unpredictable nonce permits framework hydration and required application scripts without script-src unsafe-inline in production; injected untrusted inline script and event-handler code are blocked.
X-Frame-Options DENY and frame-ancestors none persist on protected HTML, authentication refusals and API errors.
Sign-in, session navigation, Missions, Composer and Help retain their status, cookie, origin and read-only contracts at desktop and phone widths.
Loopback HTTP and the explicitly opted-in insecure LAN mode remain usable; production HTTPS retains secure cookies and exact public-origin checks.
Nonce-bearing HTML is not reused across requests; static assets keep their existing safe caching behaviour.
rollback: If enforcement breaks a supported journey, revert only through a forward-reviewed policy change that records the reopened inline-script exposure; preserve frame denial and authentication controls. Restore a corrected nonce policy as the preferred repair.
verify_line: On a production build at 1440x900 and 390x844, sign-in, Missions dialog, Composer and Help work without CSP violations; two page requests use different nonces, an injected untrusted inline script is blocked, framing and auth refusals survive, local HTTP and HTTPS cookie rules hold, and route caching and bundle effects are measured.

verification: Implementation c9b84131 passed all ten full-gate steps by exit code on unchanged tree SHA-256 8baa0c72b84736e5b9d1c40d14976e65f72a70e4dbc434e20d865608168c89b8: lint, typecheck, 759 passing Jest suites (7,350 passed, eight skipped), Knip, canary, Turbopack production build, build purity, 332 Playwright passes (24 skipped), design census and line census. An independent standalone full Playwright run also passed 332 with 24 skips after an earlier full-gate attempt lost its owned server mid-suite. On isolated port 3902, a controlled 1440x900 and 390x844 Chromium walk opened Missions dialog, Composer Build and Help: all six states had an h1, zero horizontal overflow, page errors and CSP violations. Two document responses had different CSP values and no-store; a framework JavaScript asset returned 200 with public, max-age=31536000, immutable. The 29-route chunk-manifest measurement recorded Composer 560,664 raw/147,956 gzip bytes and Missions 293,672/91,560 bytes; this is a manifest sum, not transferred bytes. Hosted CI remains to be observed after push.
mutation: Clean implementation commit c9b84131 passed unmodified controls and killed all three T-0182 mutants through structured Jest assertion failures. Restoration and final control passed, leaving a clean tree; no NOT-APPLIED, INEFFECTIVE or SURVIVED outcome.
deviations: The initial production build exposed five Next 16 GET handler parameter type errors; those route signatures and the schedules test invocation were repaired. Missions and Composer loading actions were enabled before hydration, so they now remain disabled until ready. Zod's browser Function probe emitted a caught CSP violation; supported jitless mode removed it. Next's pre-rendered global-error page lacks a nonce; accepted ADR-0016 pins fail-closed framework violations. One gate run lost its owned server mid-E2E without a recorded application exception; it was retained as an infrastructure failure. A same-worker standalone E2E pass and then the entire unchanged-tree gate passed. The final dual-pattern oracle's Webpack branch has not been rerun.
